title: Polyvinyl
body:
Show off your record collections in a groovy new style with Polyvinyl!

**Currently Supported:**
- All Vanilla discs, including the upcoming Chaos Cubed drop.
- [Discs Where Discs Shouldn't Be](https://modrinth.com/project/wA5VlakK)
- [Volume Gamma](https://modrinth.com/project/Wo4shKNJ)
- [End's Phantasm](https://modrinth.com/project/JGfljjtd)
- [Supplementaries](https://modrinth.com/project/fFEIiSDQ)
- [Backported Discs](https://modrinth.com/project/W4vtjnfp)
- Custom discs for an upcoming version of my modpack.

Vanilla tested on 1.20.1 and 26.2, mods tested on Fabric 1.20.1
